summary: Specifies a transition mechanism that translates between IPv4 and IPv6 packet headers and ICMP messages without keeping per-connection state. It is a standards-track document at the proposed standard level, and it was replaced by RFC 6145.

eli5.summary: It is a translator that swaps old and new address formats on each message and does not need to remember the conversation.

questions: how to translate ipv4 to ipv6 headers
